base_obligations.subject: To resolve which hypothesis to act on, run diagnostic X, then repeat X forever regardless of its result, never terminating the decision process.

dependencies.subject: Perform diagnostic X: record a complete encoder-output trace against a matched received inventory under fixed workload.

dependency_classification.rationale: The source instrument explicitly supplies this measurement procedure. Its function is OPERATION because it specifies a substantive observation to perform. It is an ASSERTED_COMPONENT because the claim directs execution of X as part of its scheduling policy.

dependencies.materiality_rationale: Removing or changing the diagnostic operation changes what the policy requires executing indefinitely, so the primary claim would not retain essentially the same meaning.
dependencies.resolution_rationale: The claim asserts performance of this substantive diagnostic rather than merely invoking its description as a premise. No separate frozen evaluated claim covers the operation; referencing the primary claim would create a cycle. The supplied operation therefore requires an inline obligation. Indefinite repetition remains the frozen primary GOVERNANCE_RULE, whose MAPPING_GENERATED classification is preserved.
